text.p: Shares in French electrical distribution company Schneider rose sharply on Thursday, adding 2.64 percent to 295.6 francs at 1157 GMT. The market was down 0.99 percent.
Brokers said there appeared to be no fresh factors but that the stock had been very weak recently and could be correcting.
A company official said "It's probably a technical correction after the strong falls in the last few days," adding that he knew of no particular reason for the rise.
Schneider reports 1996 results on March 26. There is a market consensus of 1.4 billion francs net attributable profit.

One big French brokerage has pencilled in a net attributable gain of 1.23 billion francs and earnings per share of 9.7 francs, compared to the consensus estimate of 11.56 francs from consultant Jacques Chahine Finance.
Another large French broker estimates 1.15 billion francs for net attributable profit.

The earnings estimates can depend on treatment of exceptionals and goodwill amortisation, the first broker said. For instance, Schneider has a 600 million franc annual charge on the writedown of its Square D acquisition.
